name: Amazon CloudWatch Logs
description: Collects API Gateway access logs and Lambda execution logs for the production stack.

log_groups.name: /aws/lambda/ironwallengraving-*
log_groups.description: One CloudWatch log group per production Lambda function.

metric_filters.name: ironwallengraving-payment-completed-outbox-terminal-failed
metric_filters.description: Counts payment-completed outbox rows that reached terminal failure.

metric_filters.name: ironwallengraving-inventory-reservation-release-blocked
metric_filters.description: Counts inventory reservation rows moved to release_blocked.
